title: The Deflationary Panic (2008 / 2020 Simulation)
description: Inspired by the 2008 Financial Crisis and the 2020 COVID crash. The stock market collapses violently. The Federal Reserve panics and slashes interest rates to zero. Long-term bonds ($TLT) skyrocket. Our algorithm detects the severe Risk-Off regime, completely halts equity buying, and dynamically rotates 90% of the portfolio into $TLT, generating capital appreciation while the rest of the market burns.
astExplanation: The user enabled Defensive Rotation. For entries, the AST requires strong fundamentals (Positive Free Cash Flow, >50% Institutional Ownership), trend confirmation (Golden Cross, MACD > 0), and bullish options sentiment (P/C < 1). During the panic, the AST evaluator blocks all entries because the macro regime triggers the defensive override.

title: The Inflationary Bear Market (2022 Simulation)
description: Inspired by the 2022 Inflation shock. Inflation spirals out of control, forcing aggressive rate hikes. Both Equities and Long-Term Bonds crash simultaneously. Standard 60/40 portfolios are decimated. Our algorithm recognizes that $TLT is broken, rotates into $SGOV (Short-term Treasury Bills), and quietly collects a high risk-free dividend yield while waiting for the dust to settle.
astExplanation: Same AST as above. However, because $TLT is also in a downtrend (TLT Price < TLT SMA 50), the algorithm intelligently selects $SGOV as the safe haven instead, proving its dynamic adaptability.

title: The Relentless Melt-Up (2019 / 2021 Simulation)
description: Inspired by the liquidity-fueled bull markets of 2019 and 2021. The market experiences historically low volatility and a relentless upward drift. The algorithm confidently stays Risk-On, deploying capital into high-beta equities and aggressively riding the trend without getting shaken out.
astExplanation: Since the macro regime is SAFE, the Defensive Rotation is dormant. The AST engine systematically scans the equity basket, only entering stocks that meet the strict combination of fundamental cash flow, institutional backing, and technical trend criteria, generating significant Alpha over the benchmark.

title: The Geopolitical Shock (2018 Simulation)
description: Inspired by the sudden, violent chop of geopolitical events like the 2018 Trade War. High volatility with sharp drawdowns and aggressive rallies. The algorithm successfully navigates this by frequently rotating to cash or safe havens during structural breakdowns and utilizing tight stop losses to survive the whipsaws. NOTE: This backtest represents pure technical survival. In the live API, our AI Macro Analyzer parses live news headlines to preemptively rotate into cash before technicals even break.
astExplanation: The AST Defensive Rotation kicks in repeatedly, bouncing between risk-on and risk-off. It perfectly illustrates how an un-emotional state machine protects capital during extreme uncertainty.
